newsitem.title: UK: European cotton quiet, inquiry in thin.
newsitem.headline: European cotton quiet, inquiry in thin.

text.p: The Assumption Day holiday closed several European markets and those that were open lacked new feature, with only occasional enquiry for autumn shipment that was mostly of a price-testing nature.
For shipment further forward, African Franc Zone cottons remains the benchmark against which other quoations are measured - at least until a clearer view emerges of marketing policy in Uzbekistan.
